title: Recursive Synchronous Observers (Byzantine Back Channels)
pattern: Synchronous circular dependency chain where observer notifications result in recursive calls back to the producer to restore consistency.
why_bad: Tight coupling and stack overflow hazards. Makes program execution extremely difficult to reconstruct and trace.
detection: Synchronous call graphs containing cycles where downstream operations call back upstream components.
counterexample: Self-contained, bounded recursive data structure transformations (like composite pattern operations).
fix: Decouple notifications via asynchronous event queues or pub/sub channels.
